messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert — ingress-proxy (us-west-2) high 5xx spike. 2.3k errors in 5m, error rate ~38%, p95 latency 1.2s. Root cause unknown. Pager: @ashwin

ashwin: acked — I'm oncall. starting triage. any recent deploys?

maria: noticed increased 502s from nginx-ingress around 10:02. We pushed a small config rotate to ingress upstreams ~10:00 (tls renewal automation). looks suspicious.

chloe: +1 on tls rotate. Also seeing a pattern: many upstreams returning "upstream prematurely closed connection" in the logs. may be TCP resets from backend pool-B.

leo: synthetic health checks for /health in us-west-2 fail with 502/504 intermittently. curl from monitoring host gets: 

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/health
* Connected to lb-usw2.redwood (52.23.11.3) port 443 (#0)
* ALPN, offering h2
> GET /health HTTP/2
< HTTP/2 502
< server: ingress-proxy
< x-upstream: pool-B-12
< content-type: text/plain
Bad Gateway
```

ashwin: good logs. can we confirm which pool is serving most traffic?

maria: traffic split shows pool-B at 85% for last 10m after autoscaler warmed new nodes there. pool-A stable.

chloe: nginx status dump shows many "recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)" to IPs in pool-B. suspect process OOM or keepalive exhaustion.

ashwin: check recent deploys on pool-B. who pushed the model-serving infra changes?

maria: infra-deploy triggered a rolling restart of model-worker nodes at 09:58. That coincides. The restart script updated grpc keepalive settings.

leo: pulling kernel logs from one affected node: 
```
Mar 15 09:59:01 worker-12 kernel: oom_kill_process: Killed process 2345 (model-worker) total-vm:...
Mar 15 09:59:02 worker-12 systemd: model-worker.service: main process exited, code=killed
```

ashwin: OOM on pool-B node(s) explains resets -> 502. immediate mitigation: 1) route traffic away from pool-B, 2) restart ingress-proxy on a subset (drain) 3) revert keepalive change or roll node config back.

chloe: creating rollback of keepalive change on pool-B nodes now (ansible: playbook revert-keepalive -> tags=pool-B). starting traffic cutover script to reduce pool-B weight to 0 over 2 minutes.

ashwin: do not fully evict until we confirm warmed capacity in pool-A. set drain timeout to 45s on active connections.

maria: running traffic shift: 
```
redwood-router update-weight --cluster us-west-2 --from pool-B --to pool-A --duration 120s
```

support-bot: alert: Customer-facing errors spike. Top impacted: webhook deliveries (retrying), API requests with larger payloads time out. Noted surges from accounts: acme-inc, buildly.

leo: verifying p95 after shift — 30s in. error rate dropped from 38% -> 6%. latency p95 back to 220ms.

ashwin: good. keep monitoring. Chloe, what's status on rollback?

chloe: rollback finished on 8/10 nodes in pool-B. Remaining 2 are still rebooting (OOM cascade). I've disabled new scheduling to those nodes.

maria: ingress-proxy restart on canary hosts completed. no regressions. can confirm no HTTP/2 GOAWAYs after shift. earlier logs for reference: 
```
[ingress-proxy] 2026-03-15T10:02:25Z Upstream reset: 502 from 10.12.45.7:8443
[ingress-proxy] 2026-03-15T10:02:30Z HTTP/2 GOAWAY received: last_stream_id=1023
[ingress-proxy] 2026-03-15T10:03:10Z recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) to 10.12.45.8
```

ashwin: ok summarizing: cause = OOM/keepalive misconfig on pool-B after config rotate -> upstream resets -> ingress returns 502/504. mitigation = traffic shift away from pool-B + rollback of keepalive, restart/drain nodes. Impact = elevated 5xx for ~8 minutes, affecting webhooks and large payload API calls.

support-bot: Customer comms: CS drafted a banner: "We experienced elevated API errors in us-west-2 between 10:02–10:10 UTC. Most requests succeeded after rerouting. If you see persistent 502s, please contact support." Want engineering sign-off to post.

ashwin: sign-off from me. please post.

chloe: monitoring dashboards show stabilizing. setting a 1h watch. recommend post-incident action items: 1) revert aggressive keepalive defaults in deploy pipeline 2) add OOM policies on model-workers 3) synthetic test to emulate keepalive churn 4) add runbook step to shift traffic quickly.

leo: will open a follow-up ticket with logs + node list. tagging owners: infra-team, runtime.

ashwin: handing off to follow-up team for RCA and long-term fixes. I'll remain available for 30m for questions. cc @pagerduty

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged handoff recorded. Escalation cleared.

Incident Bot: incident status -> mitigated. closing live triage thread.
